root_cause: During integration of BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001, PR #6021 was approved by reviewer Codex at exact head 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d on replacement branch task/BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001-v2. However, auto_integrator.py::fetch_refs unconditionally included candidate.branch (defaulting to task/BFF-DEAD-ADMISSION-PIPELINE-REMOVAL-001) and fetched every collected branch with check=True before the authoritative PR head or exact SHA could recover. In an isolated bare remote where the original branch was absent or deleted and only the replacement branch existed, git fetch raised fatal: could not find remote ref refs/heads/task/ABC-001, stranding valid replacement PRs in smoke-failed.
resolution: Implemented resolve_authoritative_head_branch to select the authoritative live or bound head branch (from head_branch, review_binding, or delivery_binding) for required fetching (check=True). Secondary and default branches (such as obsolete candidate.branch or stale bindings) are fetched optionally with check=False, preventing absent obsolete refs from aborting integration. run_rebase_smoke also resolves target_branch via resolve_authoritative_head_branch. Preserved exact-head failure behavior (CommandFailure on invalid or unreachable exact head SHA; exact_head_missing when empty). Added isolated regression coverage in scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py.
code_change: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py: implemented resolve_authoritative_head_branch; updated fetch_refs to fetch authoritative branch as required and obsolete/default branches as optional with check=False; updated run_rebase_smoke target_branch; updated integrate_candidate head_branch argument. scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py: added test_fetch_refs_and_smoke_with_absent_original_branch_and_replacement_head.

verification.head_ancestry_check: git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/dev 909c4524724dc96b41e77c5c25409d273115143d verified exit 0 once fetched.
verification.fetch_refs_verification: Verified authoritative live/bound branch is selected for required fetching, absent obsolete branches do not fail with check=False, and exact head failure behavior is preserved on missing or invalid commit references.
